name: Starbucks
about: A consultancy report examining Starbucks' operational and financial challenges amid its "Back to Starbucks" turnaround strategy. Applied the Turnaround Strategy Lifecycle and the Cost-Quality Tradeoff Framework to diagnose a sharp decline in North American operating margins from 18.7% to 4.5% year-on-year, and delivered seven evidence-based recommendations to restore profitability while sustaining service quality.

name: AgriPulse CropFusion
about: A technical consultancy report designing a cloud-based big data architecture for a global agricultural IoT platform serving 15 million farmers. Compared AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud across scalability, real-time processing, cost, and compliance, and proposed a full Azure-based architecture from data ingestion through to business intelligence visualisation, with a structured risk assessment covering security, cost escalation, data integrity, and vendor lock-in.

name: KRONIK Financial Services
about: Designed and documented a Python-based data pipeline to automate loan application processing for a financial services firm experiencing 200% growth in application volumes. Addressed data quality challenges across PDF and Excel datasets using the CRISP-DM framework, performed EDA to surface key approval patterns, and recommended predictive modelling approaches including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost.

name: Aphrodite Beauty Ltd.
about: A full data analytics project for a beauty company operating across Austria, the Netherlands, and Portugal. Cleaned and prepared a multi-year sales dataset in Excel, performed exploratory and trend analysis across monthly revenue, product categories, and country-level benchmarks (2021-2023), and delivered strategic KPI recommendations to guide market expansion and product development decisions.
